name: Convergence F / W / C / L
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.6-block radius for 11 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 8 s
• Light push
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 4.75 ❤ thermal
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Blindness for 2.5 s
